g.text: Highly confined, high-contrast Si guides: fully vectorial techniques are important for accurate results. Book uses Lumerical MODE (FD, sparse matrix).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: A mode solver finds the field shape that travels unchanged at one frequency — sweep it for dispersion; use fully vectorial methods for silicon.
